verdict.rationale: The homepage shows SDK client usage (`client.source_connections.create(...)`), and Airweave publishes official packages: `llama-index-tools-airweave` and `@airweave/vercel-ai-sdk`. A published OpenAPI spec supports building against the API. Missing for 10: a dedicated SDK reference page naming the supported languages (e.g. Python/TypeScript) with install instructions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
